description.zh: 从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 1.

description.zh: 查询结束时间。如果不传入起止时间，则查询该实例的全部历史部署记录。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. If you do not specify the start time and end time, all the deployment task records of the edge instance are queried.

description.zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. To obtain the instance ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Edge Instances** page, move the pointer over the name of the edge instance that you want to manage and obtain the instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值是10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询起始时间。如果不传入起止时间，则查询该实例的全部历史部署记录。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. If you do not specify the start time and end time, all the deployment task records of the edge instance are queried.

title.zh: 查询边缘实例历史部署记录

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

Each Alibaba Cloud account can run a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS).

>  RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.
